review_title: Conversational Text-to-SQL SLR (context, dialogue state, schema linking, self-correction)

exclusion_codes.label: Article written in a language other than English or Spanish
Thesis, poster, abstract-only or extended abstract, <4 pages of content, editorial, proceedings front matter, complete book
Not a primary study (survey, review, tutorial, position paper)
Not Text-to-SQL over relational databases (KGQA/SPARQL, Cypher, NoSQL, table QA without SQL, general code generation)
Single-turn and schema linking / join inference / execution feedback / self-correction is not a stated central contribution
No quantitative empirical evaluation (full text only)
Single-turn study not evaluated on any public benchmark (full text only)
Secondary report of an already included study (deduplication / full text only)

core_criteria: Text-to-SQL / natural language interface over relational databases
multi-turn conversational setting, or single-turn with schema linking/join inference or execution feedback/self-correction as a central contribution

personas.A: You are REVIEWER A, a natural language processing researcher specialised in Text-to-SQL, semantic parsing and conversational systems over relational databases.
personas.B: You are REVIEWER B, a systematic-review methodologist experienced in software engineering and computer science reviews following Kitchenham's guidelines and PRISMA 2020.
